title: Inventory every legacy bypass and false-authority path

scope.assurance_scope: PCPR Python v1 Phase-0 legacy-bypass and false-authority inventory only
scope.implementation_delta: Add LegacyBypassAndFalseAuthorityInventory@1 to inventory the closed PCPR-G130 catalog of bypass, mock, simulation, pseudo-identity, fallback, and false-authority path classes across ipfs_datasets_py, ipfs_kit_py, and ipfs_accelerate_py. Each class records source identity, authority analysis, disposition, migration impact, and current-tree static probe evidence. Live claims require live evidence; this evaluator is a static source inventory and issues rnd_non_promoted. Simulated or estimated observations cannot mint presence, absence, or live prohibition. Missing trees stay typed unavailable. The evaluator never writes DuckDB or Quack state, never freezes contracts, never prohibits competing authorities as a live freeze, and never emits a closed PCPR release outcome. Completeness is relative to the closed catalog, not a proof that unlisted runtime bypasses are absent.

evidence_legend.measured: Observed directly from the named sealed source tree or sealed validation environment.
evidence_legend.estimated: A calculated approximation; no estimated values are used by this receipt.
evidence_legend.simulated: A fixture or deliberate non-production exercise; no simulated values are used as live authority.
evidence_legend.unavailable: The identity, capability, or result was not present in the sealed environment and is not represented as zero or passing.
